They were led by head coach [[Tad Boyle]] in his eleventh season at Colorado. The Buffaloes played their home games at [[CU Events Center]] in [[Boulder, Colorado]] as members of the [[Pac-12 Conference]]. They finished the season 23–9, 14–6 in [[2020–21 Pac-12 Conference men's basketball season|Pac-12 Play]] to finish in third place. They defeated [[2020–21 California Golden Bears men's basketball team|California]] and [[2020–21 USC Trojans men's basketball team|USC]] to advance to the championship game of the [[2021 Pac-12 Conference men's basketball tournament|Pac-12 tournament]] where they lost to [[2020–21 Oregon State Beavers men's basketball team|Oregon State]]. They received an at-large bid to the [[2021 NCAA Division I men's basketball tournament|NCAA tournament]] where they defeated [[2020–21 Georgetown Hoyas men's basketball team|Georgetown]] in the first round before losing in the second round to [[2020–21 Florida State Seminoles men's basketball team|Florida State]]. ==Previous season== The [[2019–20 Colorado Buffaloes men's basketball team|Buffaloes]] finished the [[2019–20 NCAA Division I men's basketball season|2019–20 season]] 21–11, 10–8 in Pac-12 play to finish in a tie for fifth place.
